resources.string: Buy things, plan a trip, keep an inventory, watch the weather — Home is the crossroads.
The bar at the bottom holds the five you use most. Everything else is behind the menu icon.
Sign in to keep your profile, and change how the app looks in Settings.

Forgot your password? There is a way back now. Sign-up checks your e-mail with a code, About shows which version you have, and you can share a product, add a trip to your calendar or copy your address in one tap.
